d: Join us at Accor, where life pulses with passion!

As a pioneer in the art of responsible hospitality, the Accor Group gathers more than 45 brands, 5,600 hotels, 10,000 restaurants, and lifestyle destinations in 110 countries. You will enjoy exclusive benefits, specific to the sector and beyond, as well as strong recognition for your daily commitment.

Everything you will do with us, regardless of your profession, will offer a deep sense of meaning, to create lasting, memorable and impactful experiences for your customers, for your colleagues and for the planet.
Hospitality is a work of heart,
Join us and become a Heartist®.

Ability to adapt to lean methodology
PC skills with proficiency in word processing, spreadsheet, project, and presentation software

d: Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

The Accountant R2R is responsible for ensuring the accuracy and integrity of the company's balance sheet through meticulous review and substantiation of each balance sheet GL account. The role involves ensuring the timely and accurate closure of books every month, supporting audit processes, and engaging with stakeholders to maintain compliance with IFRS/IAS and Al Futtaim Group policies. The ideal candidate will maintain the health of the company's financial records, drive processes for better reporting, and contribute to efficient financial operations.
q: Thorough knowledge of accounting practices in compliance with IFRS/IAS.
Critical thinking and problem-solving skills to deliver actionable insights.
Sound knowledge of taxation laws in the GCC and SEA.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills for stakeholder engagement.
What Qualifies You For The Role
Bachelor's degree in Accountancy/ACCA/CMA or similar qualification.
5-7 years of experience in a similar role with hands-on experience using ERP systems.
Proficiency in accounting practices complying with IFRS/IAS standards.
Experience in managing financial statement preparation and understanding its impact on income statements, cash flow, and statement of financial position.
We’re here to provide excellent service but a little help from you can ensure a five-star candidate experience from start to finish.

Before you click “apply”: Please read the job description carefully to ensure you can confidently demonstrate why this opportunity is right for you and take the time to put together a well-crafted and personalised CV to further boost your visibility. Our global Talent Acquisition team members are all assigned to specific businesses to ensure that we make the best matches between talent and opportunities. We not only consider the requisite compatibility of skills and behaviours, but also how candidates align with our Values of Respect, Integrity, Collaboration, and Excellence.
As part of our candidate experience promise, we also want to make ourselves available to you throughout the application process. We make every effort to review and respond to every application.
r: Prepare GL schedules (reconciliations) monthly and engage with relevant stakeholders to gather information for meaningful reconciliation.
Provide actionable insights through schedules to pre-empt issues and take timely action to drive resolution.
Review trends, identify patterns, and opportunities to strengthen controls.
Standardize schedules and follow a quality review process.
Engage with business unit finance teams to discuss findings from GL schedules.
Follow IFRS/IAS and AFG policies in the accounting process, including practical application of IFRS16.
Post accounting entries based on agreed principles and guidelines.
Review recurring provisions, accruals of expenses, and amortization, identify gaps, and validate entries.
Identify and post reclassification entries, cost allocations, and any other required entries as per the standard checklist.
Ensure timely preparation of financials and take ownership for delivery.
Provide necessary support in weekly stock forecast and month-end stock provision entries.
Submit relevant accounting information/data monthly for AFG consolidation using the Business Planning and Consolidation (BPC) tool.
Coordinate with external auditors to ensure timely submission of documentation and information.
Review related party accounts and identify mismatches.
Produce actionable insights and share with stakeholders.
Engage with business unit finance teams to drive resolutions.
Prepare review highlights in a timely fashion and monitor progress.

d: The incumbent will achieve the revenue and market share growth objectives through the assigned portfolio and through acquisition of new clients from the Corporate Banking sector. The job holder is expected to be adept with all aspects of banking services and shall suitably recommend banking, financial and risk related solutions to their clients on ongoing basis to ensure incremental market share growth. The incumbent is expected to have a thorough understanding of the local corporate banking sector and update themselves on the latest developments within the sector. The Job holder shall be required to carefully analyze the opportunities and challenges within the sector and communicate to the line management and explore suitable solutions on a regular basis.
q: University graduate with a degree in Business or Banking or Finance or any other related discipline.
Master’s degree in Management any other related discipline will be an added advantage.
08 - 12 years of total experience in financial services/banking industry, entailing responsibilities pertaining to the specific area of discipline.
Experience in business / relationship management in corporate banking, with strong understanding of the local banking industry.
r: Keep abreast of the industry or sector, its composition, players and competitive forces within the sector and the latest development within the sector, including regulatory guidelines.

Establish robust working relationships leading to acquisition of new clients and servicing of existing and new clients across product ranges available in the bank to enhance the market share and revenue growth for the bank.
Understand the wallet share of each client across product range/service and draw plans in close coordination with the TL/Section Head to increase the wallet share from each client for the bank.
Develop and maintain robust working relationships with internal/external stakeholders to facilitate and capitalize on functional / operational/ strategic needs.
Solicit new clients to bank from the corporate banking sector and ensure prompt servicing the existing clients on regular basis.
Monitor the portfolio on a regular basis to ensure facility renewals, credit ratings, documentations are done on timely basis and KYC and AML requirements are satisfied on an on-going basis.

Ensure cross sale of products including but not limited to trade finance, cash management, structured finance, corporate finance, treasury related, insurance and retail banking products and track the achievements against the assigned targets.
Contribute towards the preparation/amendment of policies and procedures within the section, in line with the regulatory/market environments / organizational mandates.

Work independently with the assigned portfolio of clients to understand their business needs and associated banking needs. Maintain a good working relationship and ensure that their banking needs are being catered to, as per the policies and procedures.
Handle preparation of credit application for new clients and ensure to review all credit applications from existing clients for annual reviews, one -off requests, facility enhancements etc.

Work closely with the team to examine the credit applications, including financial statements and translate the financial soundness of these clients onto credit assessments before providing credit recommendations to the Committee.
Ensure all credit applications duly incorporate the credit ratings, RAROC models, business and revenue model analysis, discussions on financials and risks inherent along with the mitigates.
Manage daily account-related banking activities of the clients comprising the respective portfolio and provide directions and instructions to the team in this regard.

d: The Territory Sales Leader-Secure Power & Data Centers is responsible for driving profitable growth and strengthening Schneider Electric’s position across strategic customers in Qatar.

Acting as a Key Account Manager, the role owns the commercial relationship with assigned customers, develops account strategies and pipelines, identifies new business opportunities, and mobilizes the broader Secure Power organization to convert opportunities into sustainable growth.

The role serves as the primary commercial interface for assigned Secure Power and Data Center accounts, connecting customer priorities with Schneider Electric’s portfolio of solutions, services and expertise.
Own and develop a portfolio of key Secure Power and Data Center accounts in Qatar.
Develop comprehensive account plans covering customer priorities, installed base, growth opportunities, stakeholder mapping and competitive positioning.
Build trusted relationships across customer organizations, from technical and operational stakeholders to senior decision-makers.
Understand customers’ business and critical infrastructure priorities and position Schneider Electric as a long-term strategic partner.
Conduct regular account reviews and maintain clear development plans for priority customers.
Deliver sales, order intake, profitability and growth objectives across the assigned accounts.
Identify and develop new opportunities within existing customers while expanding Schneider Electric’s presence across the Qatar market.
Build and maintain a strong pipeline aligned with Secure Power and Data Center growth priorities.
Drive opportunities from early identification and qualification through solution positioning, commercial negotiation and closure.
Maximize Schneider Electric’s share of wallet across the relevant Secure Power solutions and services portfolio.
Develop a strong understanding of customer investment plans, technology priorities and evolving infrastructure requirements.
Build relationships with key decision-makers and influencers across the Qatar Data Center and Secure Power ecosystem.
Identify emerging opportunities and translate customer needs into actionable business opportunities.
Strengthen Schneider Electric’s positioning within strategic accounts through value-based selling.
Maintain strong visibility and discipline around the sales funnel.
Ensure opportunities are appropriately qualified, prioritized and progressed.
Lead commercial negotiations and coordinate pricing strategies to balance competitiveness, customer value and profitability.
Monitor competitive activity and develop appropriate strategies to strengthen Schneider Electric’s position.
Maintain accurate forecasting and provide visibility of key opportunities, risks and actions.
Act as the commercial orchestrator for assigned accounts, bringing together the right Secure Power capabilities around customer needs.
Collaborate closely with solution, technical, services, channel and commercial teams.
Coordinate internal resources around strategic opportunities and major customer engagements.
Work across the wider Schneider Electric organization when customer needs extend beyond Secure Power.
Ensure a consistent customer experience from opportunity development through execution and ongoing relationship management.
Strong B2B sales and Key Account Management experience, ideally within Secure Power, Data Centers, critical infrastructure, electrical infrastructure or technology solutions.
Demonstrated ability to develop strategic customer relationships and translate customer needs into commercial opportunities.
Strong commercial acumen and experience managing complex sales opportunities and negotiations.
Ability to engage credibly with technical stakeholders as well as senior customer decision-makers.
Strong pipeline, opportunity-management and forecasting discipline.
Ability to operate effectively in a matrix organization and orchestrate multiple internal stakeholders around customer opportunities.
Strong knowledge of the Qatar market and Data Center ecosystem would be an advantage.
